subtitles.en: Mr. President, are you going to sell F-35s to Turkey?
subtitles.zh: 总统先生，您会向土耳其出售F-35吗？

subtitles.en: What about the legal assertions? All right.
To decision we're going to make a very good relationship.
subtitles.zh: 至于决定，我们会维持很好的关系。

subtitles.en: I would think that many people, I can tell you, many people, including the people sitting right here, to see why wouldn't we do that?
subtitles.zh: 我想很多人，包括在座的各位，都会问为什么不呢？

subtitles.en: We have a better relationship with Turkey and Turkey's been in many ways much more loyal than other countries that we think would be loyal.
subtitles.zh: 我们与土耳其关系更好，土耳其比许多国家更忠诚。

subtitles.en: So, something is different. We consider it's a great plan.
subtitles.zh: 所以，情况不同了。我们认为这是个好计划。

subtitles.en: It's the best, certainly the best plan by far.
subtitles.zh: 这是最好的，显然是最好的计划。

subtitles.en: And certainly something we will consider.
